analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but has not yet stabilized above 50. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. The 5-day low exceeding the 20-day low opens the possibility for a technical rebound, but the 52-week position at 27.2% remains low. Low trading volume reduces confidence in trend reversal. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
